# Exploratory analysis

Goals

- Identify the best threshold to remove noise; improve quantitative predictions from ML

- plotting distributions

```{r loadStuff}
library(tidyverse, quietly = TRUE)
library(grid)

# import data
base_path <- "enrichment_data/theoAptzepPCR_lokya/"
data <- read_tsv(str_c(base_path, "subset.tsv"))
```

```{r prelim-plot}
#| fig-width: 2
#| fig-height: 3

nham_count_distribution <-  function(df, print_stats = FALSE) {

  # TODO: adjust the x and y positions of annotate() based on data max/ total fct counts etc.

  counts <- summarise(df, count = n(), .by = Nham_nt)

  snp_count <- counts |> filter(Nham_nt > 0) |> pull(count) |> sum()
  indel_count <- counts |> filter(is.na(Nham_nt)) |> pull(count)

  if(print_stats) {
    # print stats
    cat("snp_count =", snp_count, "\nindel_count = ", indel_count, "\n")
    cat("total = ", nrow(df), "variants\n")
  }

  # Plot variant counts
  plt <- ggplot(counts, aes(count, fct_rev(as_factor(Nham_nt)))) + 
    geom_bar(stat = "identity", width = 1) + 

    # annotations
    labs(x = "Number of variants", y = "Number of mismatches") + # axis labels
    geom_text(aes(label = count), hjust = -0.1, size = 3) + # count of each bar
    # summary variant counts: snps, indels, total
    annotate(geom = "text", x = 100, y = 2, label = str_c("snps: ", snp_count), hjust = 0, vjust = 1.5, size = 3) +
    annotate(geom = "text", x = 100, y = 1.5, label = str_c("indels: ", indel_count), hjust = 0, vjust = 1.5, size = 3) +
    annotate(geom = "text", x = 100, y = 1, label = str_c("total: ", nrow(df)), hjust = 0, vjust = 1.5, size = 3) + 

    # aesthetics
    theme_bw() + 
    scale_x_continuous(expand = expansion(mult = c(0.1, .25))) # expand x-axis to make room for text annotations
  print(plt)
}

nham_count_distribution(head(data, 1000))
```

```{r threshold_test}
#| fig-width: 2
#| fig-height: 3

d1 <- data |> filter(if_any(matches("count"), \(ct) ct >= 2))

nham_count_distribution(d1)
```

```{r dummy-test}
#| fig-width: 2
#| fig-height: 3

dummy <- tibble(x = 1:10, y = x^2)

ggplot(dummy, aes(x, y)) + geom_point() + labs(title = "Dummy plot") + 
  annotation_custom(grob = textGrob(str_c("snps: ", snp_count), hjust = 0, vjust = 1.5, gp = gpar(size = 3)), 
                  xmax = Inf-8, ymin = -Inf)

```
